items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 38:1
items.html: AA stands in the place of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim, as above in answer 290. For the head of AA clothes the HGT of Atik, which stand in the place of the HGT of Nekudim. And Aba and Ima clothe from the mouth of AA and below, where are the NHY of Atik, which stand in the place of the NHY of Nekudim; hence Aba and Ima stand in the place of the Nukva of ZA, which is the aspect of the NHY of Nekudim. And behold, BYA are the aspect of the Chazeh and below of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim, which at the time of the breaking of the vessels were broken and died, because they spread below the Parsa; and now, in the world of correction, they must ascend and be corrected above the Parsa. Hence BYA must take the aspect of the Chazeh and below of ZA. And when ZA takes the place of AA, it is found that BYA must clothe the aspect of his Chazeh and below, which is the place of the Chazeh and below of the permanent AA, where YESHSUT and ZON now stand: Beriah must clothe in the place of YESHSUT, Yetzirah in the place of ZA, and Assiyah in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut. (Item 81).
